checks.explanation: Some consolidation in AI-driven professional-services tools is visible, but no single dominant "one lawyer service"/"one accounting service" provider has clearly emerged per vertical.
Multi-agent orchestration ("manager"/"conductor") AI frameworks coordinating specialized agent roles became commercially available through 2025.
A broad, aggregate claim about company-wide opex reduction from AI agents that is difficult to verify at the economy-wide 50% scale claimed.
A decadal-timescale prediction that has not yet had time to resolve.
TikTok was not shut down in the US; it was instead restructured/sold under a new ownership arrangement to remain operating, contrary to the shutdown prediction.
No clear evidence found of federal preemption legislation legalizing cultivated meat nationwide.
Multiple additional states, including Texas, moved to restrict or ban cultivated (lab-grown) meat following Florida's lead.
